newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl optimistic on NATO agreement by Madrid summit.
newsitem.headline: Kohl optimistic on NATO agreement by Madrid summit.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday he was optimistic NATO could reach an agreement with Russia on the alliance's eastward expansion before a Madrid summit in July.

Asked at a Berlin news conference if he believed NATO and Moscow could overcome their differences before the key meeting in the Spanish capital, Kohl said: "You might be astonished but I see a good chance."
Kohl did not go into detail on why he was optimistic at the news conference, held after a ground-breaking ceremony for Germany's new chancellery in Berlin.

NATO plans to invite the first former members of the defunct Warsaw Pact for talks on membership during the Madrid summit. Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary are believed to be among the most likely candidates.
Russia has repeatedly voiced its opposition to the plans, saying its own security would be compromised by having NATO members on its borders.
